properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js@1.1.7 (SHA-1/SHA-2 family + RIPEMD/MD5 modules) shipped as a dependency of elliptic@6.5.4 (its ECDSA internals), @ethersproject/sha2@5.5.0 and signing-key@5.5.0, and ethereum-cryptography@0.1.3; no direct call site in the application. SHA-1-class hash is the weakest quantum-relevant item here but only Grover-affected (rating D).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 ECDSA keypair (BEEFY finality-gadget authority key) generated live in src/spec.ts from well-known Substrate dev seeds and written to the genesis spec; dependency surface = @noble/secp256k1@1.6.0 (via @polkadot/util-crypto), elliptic@6.5.4 and secp256k1@4.0.2 (via ethers/web3/libp2p). Quantum-unsafe (Shor) → ML-DSA-65; algorithm fixed by the Substrate/BEEFY ecosystem (observable here, replaceable upstream).
